name: 附录A 浙江省政府各厅处机关附属机构在方岩的办公场所
name_en: Appendix A: Offices of Zhejiang Provincial Government Departments and Affiliated Institutions at Fangyan
highlights: 浙江省政府位于五峰书院，主席黄绍竑，纪念周及省政府会议均在山洞中进行
民政厅初位于岩下街新隆兴旅店，1940年迁至绍常祠堂
财政厅及省营贸易局位于五峰书院旁重楼，又大部分在老仁昌旅店办公
教育厅位于程振兴旅店，厅长许绍棣
省政府主席黄绍竑公馆位于寿山坑北面山腰，即现在五峰宾馆所在地
content_zh:
浙江省政府迁至方岩办公后，其各厅处位置如下：

浙江省政府，位于五峰书院，主席黄绍竑。纪念周及省政府会议均在山洞中进行。

浙江省政府秘书处，位于五峰书院，秘书长初为张梁任，后为李立民。

浙江省民政厅，初位于岩下街新隆兴旅店，民国29年（1940年），迁至绍常祠堂。厅长初为王先强，后为阮毅成。

浙江省财政厅及省营贸易局，位于五峰书院旁重楼，又大部分在老仁昌旅店办公。厅长初为程远帆，后为黄祖培。

浙江省教育厅，位于程振兴旅店，厅长许绍棣。

浙江省政府会计处，位于新仁昌旅店，会计长陈宝麟。

浙江省动员委员会，位于五峰路。

浙江省建设厅、浙江省政府社会处、浙江省粮食管理局、浙江省赈济会，位于永康境内其他地区。

浙江省保安处、军官区司令部、浙江省抗日自卫队总司令部，留在金华。

同时迁到方岩的省政府平行机关：

中国国民党浙江省执行委员会，位于五峰旁的空地上，一座由胡库人新建的木构二层楼房内。

浙江省高等法院，位于岩下街南端回龙桥边程氏宗祠（又说程铿别墅），院长郑文礼。

浙江省高等法院检察处，位于岩下街南端，一周姓人家院内，首席检察长王秉彝。

位于岩下街和寿山坑内的浙江省各厅处附属机构：

浙江省地政局、土地测量总队，在民政厅内，即新隆兴旅店，后迁至绍常祠堂。

浙江省警察大队，位于周氏宗祠。

浙江省民政厅公馀进修会，位于岩下街。

浙江省电报局、邮政局及电话局，位于五峰路，租用程中财家3间半民房。

浙江省民政厅卫生处、医疗防疫大队、省会卫生事务所及卫生试验所，位于五峰路及世雅。其中抗战医院位电报、电话局对面，租用四间半民房。

浙江省立建国小学（政府工作人员子弟学校），位于五峰书院内。

浙江省立方岩小学，位于岩下街北端民房内。

浙江省史料征集委员会，位于鸡鸣峰南麓的万成庙内。

浙江省国民通讯社，位于程振兴旅店。

浙江省天赋管理处，位于岩下街北端金标祠堂。

民族夜校，位于岩下街北端，橙麓村民房内，后为程元昌旅店。

省政府主席黄绍竑公馆，位于寿山坑北面山腰，即现在五峰宾馆所在地。

民政厅厅长阮毅成公馆，位于鸡鸣峰南麓，万成庙前。

抗战阵亡将士纪念碑，1939年7月7日建于桃花峰北。
content_en:
After the Zhejiang provincial government moved to Fangyan, the locations of its departments were as follows:

Zhejiang Provincial Government, at Wufeng Academy, with Chairman Huang Shaohong. Weekly commemorations and provincial government meetings were held in caves.

Provincial Government Secretariat, at Wufeng Academy; Secretary-General initially Zhang Liangren, later Li Limin.

Department of Civil Affairs, initially at Xinlongxing Inn on Yanxia Street, moved to Shaochang Ancestral Hall in 1940. Department head initially Wang Xianqiang, later Ruan Yicheng.

Department of Finance and Provincial Trade Bureau, at the multi-story building beside Wufeng Academy, with most operations at Laorenchang Inn. Department head initially Cheng Yuanfan, later Huang Zupei.

Department of Education, at Cheng Zhenxing Inn; Department Head Xu Shaodi.

Government Accounting Office, at Xinrenchang Inn; Chief Accountant Chen Baolin.

Mobilization Committee, on Wufeng Road.

Department of Construction, Social Affairs Office, Grain Management Bureau, and Relief Committee, in other areas of Yongkang.

Security Office, Military District Command, and Anti-Japanese Self-Defense Force Headquarters, remained in Jinhua.

Parallel government institutions also moved to Fangyan:

KMT Zhejiang Provincial Executive Committee, in a newly built two-story wooden house on the open ground beside Wufeng, built by people from Huku.

Zhejiang Provincial High Court, at the Cheng Clan Ancestral Hall by Huilong Bridge at the south end of Yanxia Street (also said to be Cheng Keng Villa); President Zheng Wenli.

High Court Prosecutor's Office, in a Zhou family courtyard at the south end of Yanxia Street; Chief Prosecutor Wang Bingyi.

Affiliated institutions in Yanxia Street and Shoushan Pit:

Land Bureau and Land Survey Corps, within the Civil Affairs Department (Xinlongxing Inn), later moved to Shaochang Ancestral Hall.

Police Brigade, at Zhou Clan Ancestral Hall.

Civil Affairs Department After-Hours Study Association, on Yanxia Street.

Telegraph, Post, and Telephone Bureaus, on Wufeng Road, renting three-and-a-half rooms of the Cheng Zhongcai family home.

Health Office, Medical Epidemic Prevention Brigade, Provincial Health Affairs Office, and Health Laboratory, on Wufeng Road and Shiya; the wartime hospital was opposite the telegraph and telephone offices, renting four-and-a-half rooms.

Provincial Jianguo Primary School (for government staff children), within Wufeng Academy.

Provincial Fangyan Primary School, in private houses at the north end of Yanxia Street.

Historical Materials Collection Committee, in Wancheng Temple at the southern foot of Jiming Peak.

Provincial News Agency, at Cheng Zhenxing Inn.

Natural Resources Management Office, at Jinbiao Ancestral Hall at the north end of Yanxia Street.

Ethnic Night School, in private houses at the north end of Yanxia Street in Chenglu village, later at Cheng Yuanchang Inn.

Chairman Huang Shaohong's residence, on the northern slope of Shoushan Pit, now the site of Wufeng Guesthouse.

Civil Affairs Department Head Ruan Yicheng's residence, at the southern foot of Jiming Peak, before Wancheng Temple.

War Dead Memorial, built north of Taohua Peak on July 7, 1939.
